build_simple_mlp: build a deterministic MLP with from_config using feature_sizes and init_base_rng
build_dropout_mlp: build a DropoutMLP with from_config using feature_sizes, drop_rate, and init_base_rng
test_mlp_forward: test the MLP forward pass by calling the model with a pz.nx.zeros input array
test_mlp_dropout_forward: test the DropoutMLP forward pass with a random_stream and pz.nx.zeros input
train_mlp_xor: train an MLP on XOR data using basic_training.StatefulTrainer with optax.adam optimizer
